lead: Building the new traffic signal at Menifee Rd and Diamond Rd in Menifee ($498,590), which also upgrades the pedestrian ramps to ADA standards and includes asphalt pavement improvements.
notes: Source: Valley News, Oct 1, 2026 (Menifee City Council 5-0 vote on Sept 16). The job is about 8 miles from the yard, and broken curb-ramp concrete and cut asphalt from the corners will need a place to go. They're based in Compton, so a close dump site saves them trucking. Ask for the project manager or superintendent on the Menifee/Diamond signal.
